scope: Review correction and global phase-recovery feature selection; synthetic supervised closed world, no general language or SS superiority claim.
candidate_search: All nonempty global masks of 1 to 6 provided fields; candidate labels supplied by training pairs; positive-only support retains full keys.
selection_rule: All unique training context-label pairs must recover correctly above MIN_SCORE and MIN_MARGIN. Rank eligible masks by field count, projected key count, canonical mask. Otherwise keep full context.
ss_equation: H=sum(conj(k_u)*mean(v_y|u)); score(u,y)=Re(v_y^H*(k_u*H))/D. Conditional means prevent repeated-key gain; enumeration, grouping and complexity ranking are ordinary Python/NumPy.
matched_symbolic: Same candidates, groups, label means, gates and complexity order; scores are exact conditional class frequencies, not phase correlation. Same downstream SS memory compiler and D.

synthetic.label_noise: 0 or floor(10% n), minimum 1 flipped training label
synthetic.standard: 24 training, no flips; all methods, dimensions, two seeds
synthetic.stress: all other training/noise settings; all four methods, D=2048, first seed
synthetic.ablation: standard SS with selector H=0, D=2048, first seed; final memory training unchanged

same_entity_policy: Inference supports repeated lexical entities; pair learner rejects subject==object because automatic unique lexical alignment is ambiguous. This is an explicit training limitation, not silent support for such pairs.
acceptance: matched symbolic and ID3 standard language exact
SS selection zero-H control has no eligible projections
runtime numeric-only transfer and inference remains disabled
threshold registry, artifact integrity, functional tolerance controls and self-contained CLI tests pass
non_gates: SS superiority over symbolic or ID3
low-dimensional or label-noisy tasks perfectly solved
P1 chip masking, S1 demodulation, variable event count and inference (not implemented in v0.9)
reproducibility: Freeze code/data/protocol before evaluation; two deterministic result runs compared excluding environment/timing. Exact release manifest remains required; functional coefficient atol=rtol=1e-12 plus exact decisions is separate. Evaluator code independent, data synthetic not human annotated.
